from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545996/attempts/5cf2b78706ee41199c1d98a935301463/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        color = row[0]
        if color == background:
            continue
        last = max(i for i, x in enumerate(row) if x == color)
        for c in range(last + 1, len(row)):
            if row[c] == background:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
task_file=programs/'task-db0dd402.py'
task_file.write_text(source)
namespace={}
exec(compile(source,str(task_file),'exec'),namespace)
transform=namespace['transform']
